name: Echo Volume Buttons
description: Takes over the hardware volume buttons. A press changes the device volume, or the assistant volume while a voice reply is playing, and holding a button speeds up. Turn on Kiosk > Disable volume buttons so the system doesn't change the volume as well. Part of the Echo Show Dashboard.
author: partytimeexcellent

settings.title: Volume buttons change
settings.description: Device volume is the overall level. Media volume is music's share of it, so it can't go louder than the device volume.

settings.title: Assistant volume during a voice reply
settings.description: While the assistant is talking (and for a few seconds after), the buttons change only the assistant's voice.

settings.title: Step per press
settings.description: The device volume has about 15 levels, so 7% moves it one level.

settings.title: Speed up while held
settings.description: Holding a button steps faster the longer it's held.

settings.title: Show the level in a small window
settings.description: The Echo Show Dashboard shows the level on its own. Turn this on for other dashboards.
